title: Is Accenture (ACN) an Undervalued AI Opportunity After Its Sharp Selloff?

content_html:
Diamond Hill Capital, a First Eagle Investment Management company, issued its Q2 2026 investor letter for its "Large Cap Strategy". A copy of the letter is available to download here. The Strategy returned 3.42% net of fees, trailing the Russell 1000 Value Index's 13.87% gain. Performance benefited from stock selection in consumer staples, materials and consumer discretionary, along with an underweight in utilities. However, stock selection in information technology, health care and industrials detracted from relative performance. AI remained the dominant market theme, driving an 81% gain in technology, while energy declined after the Iran war ended and oil prices fell. The Strategy's limited exposure to companies benefiting from AI-related capital spending caused most of its underperformance, while software holdings remained pressured by concerns about AI disruption. Despite elevated market valuations, the team continues to find attractive opportunities through bottom-up research and expects active management to support better-than-market returns. In addition, please check the Strategy's top five holdings to know its best picks in 2026.

In its second-quarter 2026 investor letter, Diamond Hill Capital Large Cap Strategy highlighted Accenture plc (NYSE:ACN). Accenture plc (NYSE:ACN) provides strategy and consulting, industry X, song, and technology and operation services across Americas and internationally. On July 31, 2026, Accenture plc (NYSE:ACN) closed at $165.92 per share. One-month return of Accenture plc (NYSE:ACN) was 22.05% and its shares lost 35.40% over the past 52 weeks. Accenture plc (NYSE:ACN) has a market capitalization of $103.75 billion.

Diamond Hill Capital Large Cap Strategy stated the following regarding Accenture plc (NYSE:ACN) in its Q2 2026 investor letter:

"Shares of global information technology services company Accenture plc (NYSE:ACN) underperformed after the company reported weaker-than-expected results, noting that near-term demand for its services remained subdued. These results reinforced investor concerns that AI could disrupt portions of its business. However, we believe the company remains well positioned within the broader information technology ecosystem, and its valuation remains attractive relative to its long-term prospects."

Accenture plc (NYSE:ACN) is not on our list of the 40 Most Popular Stocks Among Hedge Funds. As per our database, 64 hedge fund portfolios held Accenture plc (NYSE:ACN) at the end of the first quarter which was 71 in the previous quarter. While we acknowledge the potential of Accenture plc (NYSE:ACN) as an investment, we believe certain AI stocks offer greater upside potential and carry less downside risk. If you're looking for an extremely undervalued AI stock that also stands to benefit significantly from Trump-era tariffs and the onshoring trend, see our free report on the best short-term AI stock.

First Eagle 投资管理公司 Diamond Hill Capital 为其“大盘股策略”发布了 2026 年第二季度投资者信函。 该信函的副本可在此处下载。 该策略扣除费用后的回报率为 3.42%，落后于罗素 1000 价值指数 13.87% 的涨幅。 业绩受益于消费必需品、材料和非必需消费品的股票选择，以及公用事业的减持。 然而，信息技术、医疗保健和工业股的选股影响了相对表现。 人工智能仍然是市场的主导主题，推动技术增长 81%，而能源在伊朗战争结束和油价下跌后下跌。 该策略对受益于人工智能相关资本支出的公司的敞口有限，是其表现不佳的主要原因，而软件持股仍因对人工智能颠覆的担忧而承压。 尽管市场估值较高，但该团队继续通过自下而上的研究寻找有吸引力的机会，并预计积极的管理将支持优于市场的回报。 此外，请查看该策略的前五名持股，以了解其 2026 年的最佳选择。

Diamond Hill Capital Large Cap Strategy 在其 2026 年第二季度投资者信中重点关注了埃森哲公司（纽约证券交易所股票代码：ACN）。 埃森哲公司（纽约证券交易所代码：ACN）在美洲和国际范围内提供战略和咨询、行业X、歌曲以及技术和运营服务。 2026 年 7 月 31 日，埃森哲公司（纽约证券交易所股票代码：ACN）收于每股 165.92 美元。 埃森哲公司（纽约证券交易所股票代码：ACN）的一个月回报率为 22.05%，其股价在过去 52 周内下跌了 35.40%。 埃森哲公司（纽约证券交易所股票代码：ACN）的市值为 1037.5 亿美元。

Diamond Hill Capital Large Cap Strategy 在其 2026 年第二季度投资者信函中就埃森哲公司（纽约证券交易所股票代码：ACN）发表了以下声明：

“全球信息技术服务公司埃森哲公司（纽约证券交易所股票代码：ACN）的股票表现不佳，该公司公布的业绩低于预期，并指出近期对其服务的需求仍然低迷。 这些结果加剧了投资者的担忧，即人工智能可能会扰乱其部分业务。 然而，我们相信该公司在更广泛的信息技术生态系统中仍处于有利地位，其估值相对于其长期前景仍然具有吸引力。”

埃森哲公司 (NYSE:ACN) 并未出现在我们的对冲基金 40 支最受欢迎股票名单中。 根据我们的数据库，截至第一季度末，有 64 个对冲基金投资组合持有埃森哲公司（NYSE：ACN），而上一季度为 71 个。 虽然我们承认埃森哲公司（纽约证券交易所股票代码：ACN）作为一项投资的潜力，但我们相信某些人工智能股票具有更大的上涨潜力，并且下行风险较小。 如果您正在寻找一只被极度低估的人工智能股票，并且该股票也将从特朗普时代的关税和离岸趋势中受益匪浅，请参阅我们关于最佳短期人工智能股票的免费报告。
